title: Fruit Into Baskets
summary: Find the longest run of consecutive trees that contains at most two kinds of fruit.

tests.explain: Only two kinds of fruit exist, so all three trees can be picked.
Starting at the 1 you can take 1, 2, 2: three trees. Starting at the 0 you must stop after 0, 1.
Start at the first 2: 2, 3, 2, 2 uses two types and is 4 trees long.

hints: Rephrase the story: find the longest contiguous subarray that contains at most 2 distinct values.
Grow a window to the right one tree at a time, counting how many of each fruit type are inside it. If the window now holds 3 types, it is invalid.

While the map has more than 2 keys, shrink from the left: decrement the count of fruits[left], delete the key when it reaches 0, and move left forward. After each step update the best length as right - left + 1.

complexity.time: O(n): left and right each move across the array at most once
complexity.space: O(1): the map never holds more than 3 entries
